verdict.rationale: Better Auth versions its library through semver-tagged releases, a vendor-hosted changelog with "Action required" callouts on breaking changes, minor-version upgrade guides, and documentation versioned per release line (v1.6, v1.7, v1.8 beta). However, the evidence states that no standalone deprecation-window or support-policy document exists, so the deprecation-policy half of the story is not delivered. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy with notice windows, a support/LTS policy per release line, and independent corroboration of versioning discipline.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: semver-tagged with "Action required" callouts on breaking entries, plus minor-version upgrade guides
The documentation is versioned per release line (v1.6, v1.7 latest, v1.8 beta), with the directive "Use the documentation version that matches the Better Auth version installed in the project."
